name: Alten S.A.
summary: Alten S.A. operates as an engineering and technology consultancy company in France, North America, Germany, Scandinavia, Benelux, Iberian, Italy, the United Kingdom, the Asia-Pacific, Switzerland, Eastern Europe, and internationally. It undertakes projects for the technical, research and development, and information systems divisions of industrial, telecoms, and service clients. The company also provides engineering services, such as mechanic and materials, data management, systems engineering and PDM, project management office, quality assurance, manufacturing, environment, health and safety, electronics; embedded software; and construction infrastructure services.
